notes.title: There are 20 levels and 40 achievements available!
notes.content:
Improved the level design, added a lot of complex rotating saws.
Added new music tracks.
The voice of the main character is replaced, now the cat likes to purr!
A total of 40 achievements and 20 levels are available.
Secret Achievements need to be found and touched.
